description: The plot illustrates the variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate on the HateXplain dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Model Variants" and has a categorical scale with five distinct labels: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66 with a tick label interval of 2. The plot contains three lines representing precision, recall, and F1-score, colored blue, brown, and purple, respectively, each with a circle marker and a solid line style. The precision line starts at 65.45% for the full model and decreases to 61.06% without prompt, then increases to 62.22% without augmentation, followed by a slight decrease to 64.06% without attention, and finally remains nearly the same at 65.44% without both prompt and augmentation. The recall line begins at 65.78% for the full model, drops to 59.64% without prompt, rises to 63.75% without augmentation, then declines to 59.17% without attention, and further decreases to 56.82% without both prompt and augmentation. The F1-score line starts at 65.56% for the full model, decreases to 60.16% without prompt, increases to 62.63% without augmentation, then drops to 59.67% without attention, and finally decreases to 57.74% without both prompt and augmentation.
